jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. jobs.description: About HappyRobot HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. Role Overview We are looking for a Deployment Strategist to join our team. You're the partner who keeps the work pointed at the highest-impact outcomes, ready to pick up the keyboard alongside the FDE when the moment calls for it. We're looking for engineers with strategic instincts: people who can write code, but whose deepest strength is the strategic, opinionated lens they bring across every phase of a deployment - spotting where value lives, scoping it realistically, and partnering with engineers to capture it from prototype to production. The art is deeply understanding how to maximize value of this use case for the customer, not just delivering what was asked for. On technical effort, map integrations, data, and platform constraints, and surface the edge cases and dependencies that shape timelines. Land on a plan that's realistic on both. Prototyping : Build prototypes and demos hands-on. Use our platform and AI-powered coding tools to test ideas end-to-end at light scope. Prove value early, before the customer commits. Program Management : Coordinate work across the active deployments in an account. Be the escalation point for the customer and the watchout partner for the FDE. Stay close enough to the build that you both understand the use case deeply, spot opportunities to capture more value, and catch when work is drifting from the highest-impact path. Prioritization : Sequence use cases within an account so each deployment compounds the next. Make the call on what gets built when, what gets parked, and where to invest discovery and building time. Customer Partnership : Be the main business-side point of contact for the account. Build trust with operational and executive stakeholders day-to-day. jobs.title: Supply Chain Manager
jobs.description: About pplwise pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics. About our client: Filics Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Supply Chain Manager (m/f/d) at Filics, you will build the supply chain that takes the robots into series production. About the role This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly. Filics robots are built from hundreds of components. Many come from a single source, and most aren’t under contract yet. Moving from prototypes to series production, one missing part can stop the whole line. Your job is to build a robust supply chain from scratch. It needs to know exactly what Filics depends on, secure those parts before they become a risk, and hold up as volumes grow, all while production is already running. You take full ownership of how every component is sourced, secured and managed. You’ll work closely with Engineering, which owns the technical specs and qualifies suppliers and alternative components. Assembly depends on reliable supply to plan builds. Leadership sets volume commitments based on your analysis. What you’ll do Identify critical dependencies, lock in availability through supplier contracts, and qualify alternatives so no single source can stop production Set up the ERP and the systems the supply chain runs on, including supplier quality tracking Define clear quality criteria for suppliers and components together with Engineering Give the assembly team the forward visibility they need to plan builds Turn supply analysis into input for Leadership’s volume commitments Once supply is robust, reduce component prices toward a leaner bill of materials About you Several years in supply chain , procurement or sourcing for hardware products (e.g. robotics, automotive, machinery, electronics) Proven experience moving products from prototype to series production A solid grasp of BOMs, component sourcing, supplier qualification and supplier quality Strong negotiation skills and experience closing supplier contracts A hands-on, structured approach: you prioritize well, work comfortably without defined processes, and deliver Clear, concise communication in English and German What Filics offers Full ownership of a function you build yourself, with direct impact on getting the robots into series production A small, ambitious team where initiative leads to responsibility Work on a first-of-its-kind product in intralogistics An on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to Engineering and Assembly Sound like you? jobs.title: Pricing & Deal Desk Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description: At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions. Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next. We're hiring a Pricing & Deal Desk Manager within the Revenue Operations team. You'd take ownership of one of Moss's highest-leverage commercial functions: the pricing deal desk. It's already delivered real results, and it matters more every quarter as deal volume grows and Moss moves into bigger, more complex deals. What makes the role unusual is that the desk already runs on AI. An agent picks up each request, pulls the deal's scoring and call history, calculates margin, and drafts a reasoned reply; you approve, correct, or overrule it. So the job is two things at once: the reviewer who decides live deals, and the person who builds & improves the AI-based deal desk agent Your responsibilities Own the day-to-day approval flow for non-standard pricing, discounts, and commercial terms, acting as the fast, consistent escalation point for reps without slowing deals down. Build and evolve pricing governance, including discount rules, approval thresholds, and playbooks, converting recurring exceptions into documented policy. Drive deal health across the funnel: discount discipline, price realization, deal structure, and win rate by segment, diagnosing where deals leak value and fixing it. Translate customer segmentation into differentiated pricing guidance and deal strategies, partnering with Sales to get it applied in real deals, and getting it into the ruleset so it's applied consistently. Coach reps on pricing confidence and value-based selling Partner with Customer Success to adapt the pricing and deal playbook for consistency after the sale. About you Proven experience in a deal desk, pricing, commercial, revenue operations, or sales-strategy role, ideally in B2B SaaS or fintech. Experience standing up or scaling a deal desk or pricing process from scratch is a plus. Strong analytical toolkit, including SQL and/or advanced spreadsheet modeling. The ability to leverage AI to build a scalable Pricing Deal Desk model, or the appetite to learn it. The direction is a low-touch desk: the agent executes the rules, its output gets better as you correct it, and each additional deal costs less human attention than the last Fluent in English; German or Dutch is a plus. In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for: Comfortable holding the line with Sales on discount governance while staying a genuine partner to the team. A critical eye for AI output. The agent is sometimes confidently wrong, and catching that before a rep acts on it is part of the job. Brings commercial judgment: understands how reps sell and how price sensitivity shifts across customer segments. Structured and high-ownership, at ease in a fast, low-process, high-change environment. Able to move fluidly between detailed data analysis and higher-level strategic thinking. About Moss Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work. Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. WHAT YOU DO Nachhaltigkeits- & Compliance-Management: Du agierst als Haupt-Ansprechpartner für neue Umwelt- und Nachhaltigkeitsverordnungen auf EU-Ebene (u.a. zu Entwaldung, Verpackungen und Ressourcenmanagement), definierst die daraus resultierenden internen Prozesse und steuerst die zielgerichtete interne Kommunikation. Strategie & Ausschreibungen: Du verantwortest die Vorbereitung, Steuerung und Verhandlung von strategischen Ausschreibungen (z.B. im Textilbereich) und entwickelst zusammen mit der Head of Sourcing eine zukunftsorientierte, nachhaltige Sourcing-Strategie. Lieferantenmanagement & Pricing: Du hast den Beschaffungsmarkt (vor allem von nachhaltigen Materialien) stets im Blick, analysierst Preisentwicklungen und bist für die Verhandlung und Anpassung von Preisen zuständig. Services & Lieferantendatenbank: Du überwachst Dienstleistungsprozesse (z.B. im Bereich Installateure und Freelancer), treibst den Aufbau sowie die Strukturierung von Partner-Datenbanken voran und verantwortest die fortlaufende Informationspflege. Prozessoptimierung & Administration: Du aktualisierst und automatisierst kontinuierlich Beschaffungsprozesse innerhalb unserer Systemlandschaft. Zudem betreust du interne Richtlinien, Zugriffsrechte (wie z.B. bei Versanddienstleistern) sowie unseren Code of Conduct. Darüber hinaus engagierst du dich in internen Rollen, beispielsweise als FSC-Ambassador und Ersthelfer im Team. WHO YOU ARE Berufserfahrung & Verhandlungsgeschick: Du hast einige Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im Sourcing und im strategischen Einkauf, dem Einholen und Vergleichen von Angeboten sowie dem Verhandeln von Konditionen. Nachhaltigkeits-Expertise: Du hast ein starkes Interesse an nachhaltigen Materialien sowie aktuellen Umweltrichtlinien und setzt dich gerne für zukunftssichere, rechtskonforme Prozesse ein. Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du besitzt eine Affinität für Datenbanken, Automatisierung und die Pflege interner Systeme, um administrative Prozesse zu optimieren. Sprach- & Kommunikationskompetenz: Lösungsorientiertes Auftreten sowie sicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch für die Abstimmung mit internationalen Zulieferern und internen Teams. Teamgeist & Engagement: Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung im Team und bringst dich aktiv in internen Rollen ein, beispielsweise als FSC-Ambassador oder Ersthelfer. WHAT TO EXPECT DIVERSITY & PEOPLE: Come as you are! Bei LIGANOVA wird eine Kultur der Inklusion gelebt und Diversity fasziniert uns. Einzigartigkeit wird zelebriert und gefördert, weshalb uns die gemeinsame Mission „Create the best version of yourself“ eint. Denn wir finden, dass gerade Vielfalt das größte kreative Potential birgt. GREEN MINDSET: Innovative Lösungen und unser Green Board geben Impulse für mehr Nachhaltigkeit im Office und darüber hinaus. Mit der Initiative Green Campaign Cycle führen wir unsere Kunden proaktiv an das Thema Green Transformation heran und stehen bei der Umsetzung mit unserer Expertise zur Seite. INTERNATIONALITY: Neben unserem HQ in Stuttgart sind auch unsere Offices in Berlin und Amsterdam zu vollständigen Dependancen gewachsen. Wir bieten Dir Vernetzung und regelmäßigen Austausch innerhalb der Units, fernab von starren Teamstrukturen. Is it a Match? jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Angefangen hat alles vor sieben Jahren als ambitionierte Idee. Heute sind wir Marktführer für Abschlusszeitungen in Deutschland. Jedes Jahr nutzen mehr als zwei Drittel aller deutschen Abschlussjahrgänge die nuggit App, um ihre Abschlusszeitung und ihre Abschlusstextilien zu gestalten und sich damit eine Erinnerung an eine gemeinsame Zeit zu schaffen, die bleibt. Unsere Mission: Durch digitale Innovation und persönlichen Kundenkontakt sind wir für SchülerInnen der verlässliche Partner bei ihrem allerersten großen Projekt. Dafür hinterfragen wir permanent den Status Quo und entwickeln neue, kreative Lösungen. Wir sind ein kleines Team mit sehr großer Reichweite. Als Customer Success Manager (m/w/d) bist du die persönliche Ansprechperson für unsere Abschlussjahrgänge, von der Angebotsannahme bis zur Lieferung. Standardfragen beantworten bei uns Chatbot und Helpcenter, das Onboarding läuft über Videos und Formulare. Du kümmerst dich um das, was Automatisierung nicht kann: echte Beziehungen zu den Jahrgängen aufbauen und dafür sorgen, dass jedes Projekt sicher ins Ziel kommt. Das heißt kurze Wege, direkte Wirkung und viel Verantwortung. Es heißt aber auch, dass du eigenständig arbeiten und priorisieren musst. Aufgaben Betreuung: Du betreust unsere Jahrgänge per Videocall, Chat und Telefon und bist für alles da, was über Chatbot und Helpcenter hinausgeht. Projektbegleitung: Du begleitest jeden Jahrgang von der Angebotsannahme bis zur Lieferung, behältst Fristen und Freigaben im Blick und fasst nach, wenn ein Projekt hängt. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem Operations-Team zusammen, das Produktion und Lieferung steuert. Pipeline: Du hast deine Kunden eigenständig im Griff: Status, nächste Schritte, Risiken. Wo es eng wird, merkst du es vor dem Kunden. Video-Sprechstunden: Wir bauen buchbare Video-Calls auf, in denen SchülerInnen intensive Begleitung bei ihrem Projekt bekommen. Du gestaltest das Format mit und führst die Calls. Self-Service: Du erkennst, welche Fragen immer wiederkommen, und sorgst dafür, dass Chatbot und Helpcenter sie künftig beantworten. Wachstum: Wenn du Lust hast, wächst du in Upselling und Referral hinein: Textilien für Jahrbuch-Kunden, Jahrbuch für Textil-Kunden, Schulshops und Empfehlungen an andere Jahrgänge und Schulen. So arbeiten wir Persönlich ist unser Unterschied. Unsere Kunden sind 17, 18 oder 19 Jahre alt und stemmen oft ihr erstes großes Projekt. Sie brauchen jemanden, der erreichbar ist, mitdenkt und ehrlich sagt, wenn es eng wird. Automatisierung entlastet dich, sie ersetzt dich nicht. Chatbot, Helpcenter und Onboarding-Videos nehmen dir die Standardfragen ab, damit du Zeit für die Gespräche hast, die wirklich zählen. Eigeninitiative ist Pflicht, nicht Bonus. Du bekommst Ziele und Kontext, den Weg gestaltest du selbst. Niemand treibt dich an, aber alle verlassen sich auf dich. Hybrid, ehrlich gemeint. Unser neues Office liegt im Mindspace in der Uhlandstraße 32, direkt am Kudamm und bestens angebunden, mit allen Annehmlichkeiten eines Coworking Space. Alle weiteren Mindspace Standorte kannst du temporär mitnutzen. Homeoffice und mobiles Arbeiten sind selbstverständlich möglich, solange das Ergebnis stimmt. Qualifikation Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Kundenservice, Support oder Customer Success gesammelt. Wie lange, interessiert uns weniger als das, was du daraus mitnimmst. Du kannst mit jungen Menschen: locker im Ton, verbindlich in der Sache. Telefon und Kamera schrecken dich nicht ab, im Gegenteil. Du organisierst dich selbst und behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Projekten den Überblick. Du lieferst zuverlässig, auch wenn viel gleichzeitig läuft. Unsere Saison hat klare Peaks. Du arbeitest sicher mit CRM-Tools und digitalen Kanälen. Du erkennst, wenn ein Kunde mehr braucht, und sprichst es an. Vertriebserfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch. jobs.title: Sales Director mit Schwerpunkt Corporate & MICE
jobs.description: Wer wir sind Wir sind ein 4-Sterne-Hotel in Mainz-Hechtsheim – direkt an der A60, zehn Minuten von der Innenstadt und 30 km vom Flughafen Frankfurt. Unser Haus bietet 92 Zimmer, rund 810 m² Tagungsfläche in sieben Räumen (bis 410 m² am Stück), Restaurant & Bar in Planung, Gym, Sauna und kostenfreie Parkplätze. Für unser Firmenkunden- und Tagungsgeschäft suchen wir eine Vertriebsleitung, die es mit uns aufbaut. Ihre Aufgaben Sie bauen unseren Vertrieb auf – mit direkter Berichtslinie an die Hotelleitung. jobs.title: Senior RAMS Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for a RAMS Engineer to strengthen our safety and compliance team, with a particular emphasis on safety engineering for our vehicles, propulsion systems, ground infrastructure, and operations. RAMS covers Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, and Safety. This role will apply those principles across the full lifecycle of complex hardware and operational systems, helping ensure that hazards are identified early, risks are controlled, and safety requirements are supported by clear technical evidence. Although the role sits within safety and compliance rather than systems engineering, you will need a strong systems-engineering background and experience working with high-reliability, high-safety, or mission-critical systems. About us We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications. We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket. We are working hard to build something truly spectacular. To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you. At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you. Key responsibilities Establish and develop RAMS and safety-engineering processes across vehicles, propulsion systems, ground systems, facilities, and operations. Define, manage, and verify reliability, availability, maintainability, and safety requirements throughout the system lifecycle. Lead hazard identification, risk assessments, failure-mode analysis, fault-tree analysis, and other structured safety assessments. Develop and maintain safety cases, hazard logs, RAMS plans, safety assessments, compliance evidence, and technical justifications. Work with systems, propulsion, avionics, test, manufacturing, operations, and suppliers to identify hazards and implement effective risk controls. Support design reviews, test-readiness reviews, operational-readiness activities, incident investigations, change control, and corrective actions. What we are looking for Proven experience in RAMS, safety engineering, reliability engineering, or systems engineering for high-reliability, high-safety, or mission-critical systems. jobs.description: About ALPAMI At ALPAMI we're building a boutique hospitality brand. ALPAMI operates 200+ keys across the Black Forest, Switzerland, Tirol, and Munich — spanning City Boutique Houses, Tiny Houses in Nature, and Properties as a Service. We're not chasing stars; we're chasing 5-star experiences delivered in our own, unmistakably boutique way. We're bootstrapped, founder-led, and growing fast — with a clear target of 500 units next year. That means the operational engine behind our guest experience needs to scale just as fast, and that's exactly where you come in. The Role We're looking for an Operations Manager who reports directly to the MD and, from our Munich HQ, keeps the operational engine behind our guest experience running: you make sure our Customer Care team always has the relevant information at hand, support them in guest communication, and steer our local stakeholders on site. You are the nerve center of ALPAMI's day-to-day: the person who sees every property, every process, and every issue before it becomes a problem — and who fixes it before the guest even notices. This is not a job for someone who wants a quiet 9-to-5. We're a fast-growing, founder-led company, and we need someone who understands what that actually means in practice: unpredictable days, fast decisions, and a genuine sense of ownership over the outcome. We expect high reachability, hospitality is a 365 day business. If you don’t agree with that, this might not be the right choice for you. What You'll Do Own operations end-to-end — surveil and continuously improve operational processes and management standards across our entire portfolio of properties Be the single point of contact for our Customer Care team, provide them with relevant, up-to-date property information (access details, house rules, local specifics, open issues) so every guest gets a fast and correct answer Assist with guest communication — step in on complex requests, special cases, and escalations, and help keep our tone and response times consistently on brand Steer our local stakeholders on site — make sure the guest journey is smooth at every locationMonitor and act on operating room KPIs — occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, guest satisfaction scores, response SLAs, and the other numbers that tell you where to focus next Carry out on-site visits in coordination with our Operations Lead whenever quality checks, partner onboarding, training, or problem-solving require an on-the-ground presence Prioritize ruthlessly — you always know what needs fixing right now versus what can wait, and you make that call fast Solve issues immediately — you're hands-on by nature and would rather fix something yourself in the next ten minutes than schedule a meeting about it next week Lead and develop operational team members as we scale, setting the standard for how ALPAMI runs Champion guest happiness as a non-negotiable core value — every decision you make is filtered through "does this make the guest experience better?" jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><p>At Anduril Australia we are developing unmanned systems for subsurface and other domains that will leverage unsupervised autonomy for the delivery of long endurance, multi-mission capability to our customers. These projects, including but not limited to the Extra Large Autonomous Undersea Vehicle (XL-AUV) Program, require a Senior Electrical Engineer with deep electrical system design experience to architect and deliver critical systems and sub-systems. The Senior Electrical Engineer strives to leverage their experience with Electrical and Power Systems to rapidly architect, design, deliver, support, and evolve next generation autonomous vehicles through the entire product life-cycle.<br><br><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive the development and design of innovative electrical systems and products that meet the unique requirements of our company.</li> <li>Collaborate with other engineers and team members to integrate electrical systems into larger product designs</li> <li>Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers</li> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business objectives into clear electrical engineering deliverables.</li> <li>Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, including design specifications, test procedures, and technical reports.</li> <li>Ensure compliance with industry standards, regulations, and safety requirements throughout the product development lifecycle.</li> <li>Perform detailed electrical calculations, simulations, and testing to evaluate system performance and optimise efficiency.</li> <li>Troubleshoot complex electrical jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes&nbsp; and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><p><strong>Pourquoi Deliveroo ?</strong></p> <p>Lorsque l'on vous dit Deliveroo, vous imaginez sans doute d'abord les bons petits plats livrés chez vous en moins d'une demi-heure. Plutôt sympa non ? Mais c'est en coulisses que l'histoire est la plus intéressante. Nous opérons désormais à travers le monde et travaillons avec plus de 176 000 restaurants partenaires et commerces en tous genres en France. jobs.description: About MakiPeople Maki builds AI agents that help large companies hire faster and better, from screening to assessment to candidate engagement. Global enterprises use Maki to run hiring at scale, giving recruiters time back and candidates a smoother experience. With offices in Paris and London, we are now accelerating in New York. As an intern on our Implementation team, you will work on live customer rollouts and see how AI is deployed inside large organizations. You will get real responsibility and close mentorship from day one. About the Implementation team You will be joining our Implementation team and will be working with our UE-based team, collaborating across EMEA and Asia, and alongside both our Implementation Managers (IMs) and our Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs). You will also have the chance to collaborate with everyone at Maki. Most of the Implementation team’s efforts are currently focused on onboarding our (many) new clients, making sure they can use Maki to its fullest potential and that the impact we promise is delivered. Because we support large Enterprise companies, this is large-scale project management and change management, built hand-in-hand with our clients. About your mission As an Implementation Intern, you will support our Implementation Managers and Forward Deployed Engineers with a variety of operational tasks while actively contributing to live client projects. Your role is multi-faceted and cuts across several parts of the customer journey, with a strong focus on configuration, testing and cross-team collaboration. Your key responsibilities: Support client implementation: Help define candidate journeys, monitor impact, and ensure smooth onboarding. AI agent configuration: Configure Maki’s AI agents to match each client’s needs and hiring processes. AI agent testing: Run structured testing loops on the agents, analyze results, and iterate with the IMs and FDEs until the agents perform as intended. Cross-team collaboration: Work with internal teams at Maki, including Science, Tech, Ops and Customer Success Managers, to align configuration with client needs. Process optimization: Design and refine key processes to monitor implementations efficiently using ClickUp (our Implementation and Success internal tool). Contribute to strategic projects: Work on initiatives that support large-scale projects and change management for our enterprise clients. What we’re looking for Sharp attention to detail and strong problem-solving skills: You spot what others miss and enjoy getting to the root of an issue. Excellent English, spoken and written: You communicate clearly and concisely and can adapt to colleagues or clients. Startup energy: You thrive in a fast-paced environment where priorities move quickly. Ownership and an extra-mile mindset: You take responsibility for outcomes and go beyond what is asked. Analytical thinking: You can spot patterns in test results, summarize them, and recommend clear next steps. Strong project organization: You keep multiple workstreams moving with clear trackers and timely follow-ups. jobs.description: TL;DR We're building the SAP/NetSuite of the AI era for mid-sized companies in the real-world economy, starting with their supply chain operations (buy, sell, stock, produce) Founding deployment strategist : you deploy two things into real factories, in the same project, the ERP that runs their operations, and the AI agents that work inside it. Incumbents quote six figures for it, and the client gets the same software they had, just newer. Ours run in eight to twelve weeks and deliver two things at once: a new ERP that runs buying, selling, stock and production, and AI agents inside it that read the orders, recompute the production load, prepare the purchases, and ask a human only when it matters. This is not a product or a sales role, you are a deployment strategist. In one project, you replace a company's ERP and you put AI agents to work inside it. Why now Since day one, the founders have run every deployment themselves. Clients are now coming in faster than we can handle, and we need someone to own deployments. You work directly with Eric, CEO, who also leads product. That puts you as close as it gets to what success means at Piston: the success of our clients. What you'll do Deploy the ERP, with AI. AI does the heavy lifting, you do the judgment. Put the first AI agents live, during the ERP deployment. Every go-live feeds a playbook that our next deployment hires and our system integrator partners will follow. Map where the client's time goes. On site, you find the work that eats people's days: re-keying orders, chasing suppliers, rebuilding the same Excel every month. That map is the backlog of the next agents. Teach humans to work with agents. The people you deploy with have never supervised software that acts on its own. You show them how to trust it, check it and correct it. Hold the date and the budget. You size each deployment before the contract and protect that budget. Use the tools engineers build for you. Our engineers build the tools that let you deploy on your own: AI-assisted data migration from the client's old ERP and Excel files, and a builder for screens and agents. On top of the tools our engineers build, you create your own agents for the deployment itself: configuration checks, test scenarios, training material, status reports. jobs.title: Team Lead Customer Success - Southern Europe
jobs.description: About You You're a jack-of-all-trades with a passion for cool technology and interacting with people and making them happy. You're a self-starter who's good at triaging problems and working on the most important one. You've worked directly with customers for a long time and are comfortable being the face of the company to them. One of the things that pleases you most in life is customers successfully using your product, being thrilled with its value, and telling you they're happy they partnered with you. Further, you're a curious person, and you'd love the opportunity to work with a technology team that includes data scientists, algorithm experts, back-end and front-end engineers to expand your knowledge. About Us Constructor.io powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you've probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We're approximately doubling year over year despite the market slow down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We're a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things. About The Position As a Team Lead Customer Success Southern Europe, you'll be joining a rapidly growing team that helps our customers increase their revenue by improving the search and product discovery experiences of their websites and mobile apps through integrating with our services. Your responsibilities will include: Leading, coaching, and developing a team of Customer Success Managers across Southern Europe, with a focus on the main markets of France and Spain (and other Southern European countries) Ensuring customers successfully go live and continue to see measurable value from Constructor's product. Building and enabling your team to build trusted relationships across complex enterprise organizations: from engineers, data, and product teams to Heads and Directors of Ecommerce, Digital, Product, and Technology, up to VP and C-level executives. Translating technical concepts, product capabilities, and performance data into clear business value connecting Constructor's work to outcomes like conversion, revenue, customer experience, and operational efficiency. Implementing and iterating on scalable processes and best practices to support team growth. Acting as an escalation point for complex customer challenges and leading from the front when hands-on engagement is required. Requirements French is a must for this role; and additional languages are welcome bonuses. Based in EMEA, ideally in Southern Europe. At least three years leading teams, with a minimum of three direct reports. At least five years managing enterprise customer relationships in Customer Success, Account Management, Solutions Consulting, or a similar customer-facing role. Experience building trusted relationships with stakeholders ranging from technical teams and product leaders to Ecommerce Directors, VPs, and C-level executives. Strong executive presence and the confidence to lead strategic customer conversations, including QBRs and EBRs. Strong influencing and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to create momentum without direct authority. Strong problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly in a fast-moving, technically sophisticated environment. Experience in ecommerce, digital commerce, search, product discovery, or a related field is highly valued. Benefits A competitive compensation package including stock

jobs.title: Signalling Security Specialist
jobs.description: About the Role As a Telecom Signalling Security Analyst , you will combine customer-facing delivery with hands-on technical execution in sensitive telecom environments. You will: Support and operate P1 Security solutions in production contexts (notably PTM and VKB ). Conduct signalling security audits using proprietary tooling (notably PTA ) and deliver rigorous, professional reports and presentations to customers. This is a profile-focused role: we are looking for someone who can cover both audit delivery and operational support. Our teams are remote-first, with a preference for candidates who can overlap working hours with Central European Time. Tasks Key Responsibilities Customer delivery & communication Act as a technical point of contact for customers: scoping, updates, and delivery. Deliver presentations, training, and debrief sessions. Signalling Security Audits (PTA) Contribute to audit scoping (objectives, perimeter, constraints, timelines, deliverables). Prepare safe execution plans and operational safeguards. Execute signalling security audits using PTA and associated tooling in a controlled manner. Analyze results, validate findings, and assess exploitability/root cause. Draft professional technical reports in English and present findings to customers. PTM operations & IT support (ticket management) Provide IT support for the PTM IDS in the context of customer ticket workflows. Troubleshoot and maintain PTM deployments, including Linux and virtualization layers. Operate and improve day-to-day tooling/scripts used for investigations, maintenance, and deployments. Collaboration & continuous improvement Work closely with Engineering and R&D to improve tooling, detection quality, and operational processes. Maintain clear internal documentation and handover notes. Requirements Required Skills & Qualifications Technical writing (English) : ability to draft professional, structured technical reports and slide decks Client communication : strong verbal communication skills for presenting and interacting directly with customers. Telecom core & roaming security : solid understanding of telecom core architecture, roaming concepts, and where signalling security fits in real operator environments. Signalling protocols & call flows (hands-on) : ability to read and reason about SS7/SIGTRAN, Diameter, LTE/IMS and GTP-C call flows, and connect traces/observations to concrete security findings. Standards-driven audit mindset : familiarity with GSMA Fraud & Security standards (notably FS.11, FS.19, FS.20 ) and ability to translate requirements into test cases, evidence collection, and actionable remediation. Roaming signalling security : mastery of roaming signalling attacks and call flows. Linux / terminal : comfortable using a terminal and basic Linux commands. Scripting Python : Proficiency in "quick scripting" mode : Ability to develop one-off analysis or testing scripts. Virtualization / operations : experience with Linux + ESXi / VM operations (deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance) is a plus Soft skills : customer centered, autonomy, high level of rigor, proactive mindset (ability to propose solutions). This work matters. Your work matters. We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us. The Role Due to rapid growth in our partner lab network, we are seeking a Scientific Product Manager to join our Product team and bring partner labs and their experimental workflows onto the CuspAI platform. Your impact This is an exciting opportunity to join the product team at CuspAI, working closely with materials scientists, ML researchers and platform engineers to make AI-driven experimentation work in real laboratories. As one of a small team of Scientific Product Managers, you will take ownership of a set of partner labs and the lab integration work around them, translating what each lab actually needs into requirements our engineers and ML researchers can build against. Act as the main scientific counterpart for the partner labs you look after, and represent the product in partner meetings, workshops and conferences. Closed-Loop Campaigns Work with ML researchers to design optimisation campaigns (e.g. Bayesian optimisation) that respect real experimental constraints such as throughput, noise and failed samples. Define how platform-driven campaigns are validated, including benchmarks against manual or legacy workflows, success metrics and the evidence we bring to partners. Now, we're making this ecosystem fully available to our customers, both shippers and carriers.  Our system brings digital transformation to an industry long reliant on outdated processes, offering smart tools that enhance visibility, streamline compliance, and optimize operations. The result? A more efficient, transparent, and effortless way of working for everyone involved!  We’re growing fast and expanding our carrier network across Europe. jobs.title: Senior Financial Controller
jobs.description: MVRDV zoekt een Senior Financial Controller om ons Finance & Operations team in Rotterdam te versterken. Je bent de financiële rechterhand van onze Head of Finance en de dagelijkse sparringpartner voor Project Managers, Directors en collega's binnen Finance. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in zowel project control als financial control en zorgt ervoor dat financiële informatie betrouwbaar, tijdig en bruikbaar is voor de organisatie. Je ondersteunt Project Managers bij het monitoren en verbeteren van projectresultaten, terwijl je tegelijkertijd bijdraagt aan een hoogwaardige financiële verslaggeving, een betrouwbare jaarafsluiting en een succesvolle accountantscontrole. Met jouw analytische blik, financiële expertise en hands-on mentaliteit lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan de verdere professionalisering van onze financiële organisatie. MVRDV is een wereldwijd erkend bureau voor architectuur en stedenbouw, met hoofdkantoor in Rotterdam en vestigingen in Shanghai, Parijs, Berlijn en New York. Variantie- en scenarioanalyses uitvoeren en de resultaten vertalen naar praktisch advies over winstgevendheid, facturatie en cashflow. Project Managers ondersteunen bij projectopstart, maandelijkse reviews en projectafsluiting. Zorgen voor een correcte projectopzet, coderingsstructuren en kostentoewijzingen. Urenregistraties en projecttoewijzingen controleren op juistheid en consistentie. Inefficiënties in projectuitvoering signaleren en bijdragen aan margeverbetering. Financial Control Verantwoordelijk voor de coördinatie en kwaliteitsbewaking van de financiële verslaggeving en de jaarrekening, inclusief relevante specificaties, balansdossiers en aansluitingen. Verantwoordelijk voor de regie op de jaarlijkse accountantscontrole en de samenwerking met externe accountants, waarbij wordt gezorgd voor een efficiënte en succesvolle afronding van het controleproces. Bewaken van de volledigheid en juistheid van financiële processen, interne beheersingsmaatregelen en financiële gegevens ter ondersteuning van een betrouwbare jaarafsluiting. Signaleren van verbetermogelijkheden binnen financiële processen en bijdragen aan verdere professionalisering van de financiële organisatie. Ondersteunen bij maand-, kwartaal- en jaarafsluitingen en zorgen voor betrouwbare financiële rapportages. Business Control & Business Partnering Bijdragen aan bedrijfsbrede budgettering, forecasting en lange termijn planning. Helpen bij het opstellen van managementrapportages, KPI-dashboards en financiële analyses. Projectresultaten verbinden aan de totale financiële prestaties van de organisatie. Projectbudgetten afstemmen op bezetting en capaciteitsplanning. Financiële data vertalen naar heldere, bruikbare adviezen voor niet-financiële collega's. Management ondersteunen bij business cases, scenarioanalyses en besluitvorming. Wie zoeken wij? Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Finance, Bedrijfseconomie, Accountancy of vergelijkbaar. Minimaal 7 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen financial control, business control, accountancy of een vergelijkbare financiële functie. Aantoonbare ervaring met jaarafsluitingen, financiële verslaggeving en jaarrekeningen. Ervaring met accountantscontroles en samenwerking met externe accountants. Van feta-ovenpasta tot knapperige aardappelsalade en van chopped sandwich tot de omelet uit The Bear - jij was er allemaal als eerste bij. Je maakt foto’s en short-form video’s waar menig maag van gaat rommelen en je weet deze beelden tot hapklare content te maken. Kom jij ons gezellige social team per februari 2027 versterken voor een half jaar? Wat je gaat doen Je bent als eerste op de hoogte van de nieuwste foodtrends en komt met originele ideeën om hierop in te haken op een manier die past bij Crisp. Daarbij krijg je veel vrijheid om je eigen creativiteit in te zetten. Je weet welke ingrediënten er nodig zijn om de lekkerste foto’s en video’s te maken en kunt deze beelden zelf bewerken tot smaakmakende content. Met je handen uit de mouwen mentaliteit ondersteun je ons social team bij het coördineren van foto en videoshoots. Je zit niet elke dag achter je laptop, maar gaat ook regelmatig op pad, bijvoorbeeld om leveranciers te ontmoeten of content te schieten op locatie. Je helpt bij het beheren van de social media kanalen van Crisp. Je houdt de planning bij, zorgt dat alles op rolletjes loopt en draagt bij aan een dynamische, leuke rol binnen een gezellig team. Dit ben jij Je zit vol ideeën om onze socials naar een next level te tillen Je verslindt alle vormen van digitale content en Instagram en TikTok kennen geen geheimen voor jou. Je hebt een flexibele werkhouding. Een plotselinge update van Instagram brengt jou niet van je stuk. Je bent creatief en proactief. Je werkt graag zelfstandig, maar sparren met het social team vind je net zo leuk. Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal uitstekend, zowel mondeling als in schrift. Je bent 32-40 uur per week beschikbaar voor minimaal 5 maanden. Wat wij bieden Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op ons voedselsysteem en échte verandering teweeg te brengen. Enthousiaste en ondernemende collega’s om mee te werken en te leren. Een kijkje in de keuken van een van de snelst ontwikkelende bedrijven in de Europese markt. Een gratis lunch van Crisp. Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University. Tijd om je collega’s te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen. Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp. En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten. Onze selectieprocedure Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter. Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. Wij moedigen sollicitanten met diverse perspectieven en achtergronden aan om te solliciteren en geloven in gelijke kansen voor iedereen. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd. You'll be the first point of contact when customers reach out, whether they're new to the platform and need guidance or veterans troubleshooting complex issues. You'll make a real impact by solving problems, sharing insights, and ensuring our customers get fast, top-quality support when they need it most. Collaborate with the broader Customer Experience team on our goals and business objectives. Share information, news, and workarounds within the Support team. Contribute to our internal knowledge base in Confluence. Attend regular team meetings to identify, discuss, and solve any ongoing projects, process improvement ideas, product features, etc Onboard new Rentman employees during their shadowing time in Support so they learn how we help our customer. What we are looking for 1 year of experience in a customer-facing role. Fluency in English & Dutch (native or C1 level), so you can support customers comfortably in either language. A sharp troubleshooter who can track down the right answer and explain even complex solutions clearly, in writing and out loud. A team-first mentality - supporting your teammates matters to you just as much as helping customers. Comfortable in a fast-paced environment: we ship product updates every week, and you pick up what's new quickly so you can support customers with confidence. Comfortable working across teams, turning what you hear from customers into useful feedback for the rest of the business. Genuinely tech-savvy and curious - Rentman is a powerful, complex product, and you'll want to know it inside out. Mission of this role Getting equipment to and from an event, on time and in one piece, is one of the most critical things our customers do, and one of the hardest. Heavy, specialised, often fragile gear. Fixed vehicle and crew capacity. Round trips rather than one-way drops. Our customers solve this every week, mostly with spreadsheets, phone calls and hard-won instinct. Transport is a priority on our roadmap, and we're bringing in dedicated ownership to make sure we deliver on it: how customers plan loads, sequence stops and optimise routes across their fleet. This role owns that outcome from the ground up. You'll start by getting close to customers to find the first slice of the problem they'll genuinely want to have solved, ship it, and build the roadmap from there. Which features ship is yours to decide. You'll be shaping the domain and its roadmap, with the freedom to define how the product takes form. That's a rare amount of ownership for a PM, building something new from first principles, with real trust in how you get there. What you'll do Own Transport end to end: Running the full release train for your value stream: discovery, scoping, design, development, launch and post-launch tracking. Run customer discovery yourself, in the field: Talk to rental companies about how they plan, staff and execute transport today: warehouse-to-venue routing, multi-stop and multi-vehicle loads, load order, crew and vehicle capacity, and the constraints that make equipment transport harder than generic delivery routing. Define the first sellable increment. Find the smallest thing customers will genuinely pay for, ship it, and be able to explain why that slice was the right first bet. Build and own a sequenced, evidence-based roadmap with the Head of Product, aligned to company goals and product strategy. And explain the prioritisation to sales, support and management so they can plan against it. Translate routing and logistics complexity into buildable scope: multi-stop optimisation, time windows, vehicle and crew capacity, mapping and routing APIs, and the build-vs-buy decisions that come with them. Define success before you build it: Every feature carries a business goal, product briefs stay current, a live dashboard goes up at launch, and you drive go-to-market together with Product Marketing, Support, Sales and Content & Community. What we are looking for 5+ years as a Product Manager in B2B SaaS. You've owned a product area end to end. From discovery through launch and post-launch tracking, not a backlog-only PO role. You're comfortable with operationally complex problems: routing, scheduling, fleet or capacity planning, supply chain, field service. A logistics background is a plus, not a must. You work from data. You can show how you set a success metric, what you did when it was missed, and how you make the business case behind a product call. You've run customer discovery yourself, not through a research team, and you can make and defend scope calls on partial evidence. Nice to haves Product experience in route optimisation, fleet management, field service or supply chain / TMS, or hands-on experience with mapping and routing APIs and platforms (Google Maps Platform, HERE, Mapbox, route-optimisation engines). jobs.description: About Huzzle Labs Huzzle Labs partners with frontier AI labs to evaluate and improve frontier models through deep human expertise. Contributors directly assess advanced AI systems in their specialist fields, receive competitive compensation, and help define the standards used to measure model performance. About the Role Huzzle Labs is seeking experienced accountants to write realistic accounting tasks that test how well frontier AI systems handle accounting work. You will create prompts that are difficult enough for a frontier model to fail, then write a scoring rubric for each task so reviewers can assess the output consistently. A rubric is a list of objective, checkable criteria that a reviewer marks pass or fail. Your judgement helps define the standards used to measure model performance. This is an expert judgement role focused on realistic task design, careful review of model output and precise, consistent documentation. Training is provided. Prior AI training or data-annotation experience is required. Responsibilities Write realistic accounting tasks: Create requests of the kind a client, controller or business owner would send, covering month-end close, bank and credit card reconciliations, AR/AP ageing, accruals and adjusting entries, sales tax, job costing and the clean-up of incomplete or inconsistent books. Build from real material: Review a deal room containing hundreds of files, select the relevant documents and use them to develop prompts and rubrics for tasks a frontier model struggles to complete correctly. Require usable deliverables: Each request should call for a working output, usually a spreadsheet, a journal entry schedule or a short memo. Test against a frontier model: Run each request and review the output with the care you would apply when signing off accounting work. Where the model succeeds, increase the difficulty until a genuine gap appears. Write scoring rubrics: Define objective criteria that another reviewer can apply without repeating your work, for example, “the reconciled ending balance equals $X” and “the $X deposit is recorded as a customer deposit liability, not revenue.” Apply guidelines consistently: Follow the task and rubric guidelines, flag ambiguous cases and help refine the criteria. Requirements At least 5 years in accounting, bookkeeping or finance operations. Prior AI training or data-annotation experience is required. Hands-on knowledge of month-end close, reconciliations, AR/AP, accruals and adjusting entries, sales tax and job costing. Excellent written English and precision with numbers. Careful and detail-oriented: accurate figures and objective, checkable criteria. Available 20 to 40 hours per week for an initial one-week trial, with potential extension. Example Assignment For a client deal room covering a small business with incomplete and inconsistent books, you would: Review the files and select the relevant documents, such as bank statements, ledgers, invoices and ageing reports. Write a prompt as the business owner or controller would, asking for a reconciliation and the adjusting entries needed to close the month. Run the prompt against a frontier AI model and check the spreadsheet or journal entry schedule line by line. If the model completes the task correctly, increase the difficulty, for example, by adding a customer deposit, a timing difference or a sales tax complication, until it fails. Write the rubric, such as “the reconciled ending balance equals $X” and “the $X deposit is recorded as a customer deposit liability, not revenue,” so another reviewer can grade any answer without repeating the work. jobs.title: PhD Research Intern, 3D World Models
jobs.description: SpAItial is pioneering the next generation of World Models, pushing the boundaries of generative AI, computer vision, and the simulation of reality. We are moving beyond 2D pixels to build models that natively understand the physics and geometry of our world. Our mission is to redefine how industries, from robotics and AR/VR to gaming and cinema, generate and interact with physically-grounded 3D environments. We're looking for bold, innovative individuals driven by a passion for pushing the boundaries of generative 3D AI. You should thrive in an environment where creativity meets technical challenge and be fearless in tackling the hardest problems in 3D world modeling. Our team is built on a foundation of dedication and a shared commitment to excellence, so we value people who take immense pride in their work and place the collective goals of the team above personal ambition. As a part of SpAItial, you'll be at the forefront of building World Models that bridge generative AI and the physical world. If you're ready to make an impact, embrace the unknown, and collaborate with a talented group of visionaries, we want to hear from you. We're seeking PhD Research Interns to work with our research team on open problems in 3D generation and reconstruction. You should have strong knowledge of at least one of our core areas, such as generative video and diffusion models, scene representations like Gaussian splats and radiance fields, or 3D reconstruction from per-scene optimization to feed-forward models. Over a 5-7 month internship, you will own a well-defined research question with the goal of publishing a paper. Responsibilities You will explore novel research directions in 3D generation, reconstruction, and world models. You will design, implement, and evaluate state-of-the-art methods, turning innovative research ideas into working systems and prototypes. You will be working closely with our research team. You will also present your findings and contribute to scientific publications targeting leading conferences in computer vision, computer graphics, and machine learning, such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, SIGGRAPH, NeurIPS, and ICLR. Key Qualifications Currently enrolled in the third year or beyond of a PhD in computer science, computer vision, computer graphics, machine learning, or a related field. 2-3 first-author papers at top-tier conferences such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, SIGGRAPH, NeurIPS, or ICLR. Knowledge of at least one of: generative models (diffusion or video models), neural scene representations, or 3D reconstruction. At SpAItial, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure all candidates are treated fairly throughout the recruitment process. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Engineering Fellowship
jobs.description: Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented. The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But International Fintechs and non-US banks are left with two unsatisfying options to access it: Either they build on legacy clearing banks that are slow and unreliable, or they interface with middleware providers that don’t move and hold the dollars directly, but themselves rely on underlying legacy banks. Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code. We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and n8n. We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe. The Role You’re a Fellow at Augustus, deployed to special projects across engineering, product, and the wider company. You own a project end to end: understand the problem, decide how to approach it, build the solution, and get it into use. The work depends on where you can have the most impact. You could build background coding agents, create a frontend component library, or solve an operational problem with agents. The common thread is a meaningful problem, a clear outcome, and ownership of getting it done. You’ll work closely with the team your project sits in. They provide context, technical guidance, and direct feedback. You bring the drive to turn an open-ended problem into something that works. As you deliver, the scope and difficulty of your projects grow. Your First Months Get context quickly, ship early, and take on harder problems as you prove yourself. Month 1: Join a team, understand the problem, and take ownership of your first project. Talk to the people who will use what you build, agree on what success looks like, and ship an initial version. Months 2–3: Drive the project through to adoption. Work through technical decisions, collect feedback, and improve the solution. You’re becoming more independent and developing better judgment about where to spend your time. Months 4–6: Take on a larger project or a harder problem, potentially in another team. You can turn an ambiguous brief into a plan, make sound tradeoffs, and deliver with less guidance. Who Will Thrive At Augustus We care most about your trajectory, drive, and curiosity. You don’t need years of experience. You need evidence that you learn quickly, push yourself, and finish things. Steep trajectory. You’re getting better fast. The problems you can solve today are meaningfully harder than those you could solve six months ago. You seek feedback and put it to work. Drive. You make things happen. You find a way through unfamiliar problems, follow up without being chased, and stay with a project until it works. Curiosity. You want to understand how things work and why. You dig into unfamiliar systems, ask precise questions, and look beyond the first plausible answer. Ownership. You care about the outcome. You involve the right people, raise blockers early, and check that what you shipped actually solves the problem. Low ego. You can defend an idea, change your mind, and commit to a team decision. You care more about getting it right than getting credit. This fellowship is for you if: You’ve built things outside a course or job because you wanted them to exist. You want an ambitious problem and room to figure it out. You enjoy moving between unfamiliar tools, systems, and domains. You’re willing to do the less exciting

You'll be building the product that does it: the ingestion and extraction pipelines, the APIs customers build their operations on top of, and the systems that make those models useful, fast and trustworthy at enterprise scale. jobs.title: Research Scientist - Control & Machine Learning
jobs.description: At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution. We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints. With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge? Research questions you could initially work on Learning dynamics from operational data. How can we identify useful models of a plant from noisy, partially observed data collected during closed-loop control? Optimising under uncertainty. How can Bayesian optimisation improve plant performance when experiments are expensive, samples are noisy, and operating constraints must be respected? Learning while controlling. Work with process engineers to incorporate plant physics, operating knowledge and constraints into models and algorithms. jobs.title: Head of Product - H/F
jobs.description: Vos missions Vos missions Rattaché(e) à la Direction Technique, vous pilotez l'ensemble de la fonction Produit. Vous définissez la stratégie produit, arbitrez les investissements, managez l'équipe et garantissez l'alignement des moyens engagés avec les objectifs de l'entreprise. En binôme avec le Product Lead, vous portez la vision, fixez le cadre stratégique et représentez le produit auprès de la Direction Générale. Principales responsabilités * Définir la stratégie d'un portefeuille multi-produits : investissements, priorités, évolution et cycle de vie des produits. * Appuyer chaque décision sur des données mesurables (revenus, usage, renouvellements, churn, coûts, risques). * Manager l'équipe Produit (Product Lead, Product Owners, Business Analysts, Product Designers, QA Engineers) : recrutement, accompagnement, évaluation et développement des compétences. * Fédérer les équipes autour d'objectifs clairs, stables et mesurables et faire vivre une culture produit orientée qualité et performance. * Construire et piloter le budget de la fonction Produit ainsi que l'organisation des équipes et des squads. * Garantir le respect des budgets et plannings, anticiper les risques et contribuer à la résolution des écarts. * Piloter la veille concurrentielle afin d'alimenter les orientations stratégiques et les roadmaps. * Développer l'innovation et l'usage de l'IA dans les pratiques produit (discovery, spécification, design, tests, documentation), dans un cadre sécurisé et conforme. * Représenter le produit auprès des dirigeants et arbitrer les décisions majeures inter-équipes. Environnement : Jira, Figma, Confluence, outils de data produit et solutions d'IA. Vos compétences Votre profil Diplômé(e) d'une école de commerce ou d'ingénieur (Bac+5), vous justifiez d'au moins 10 ans d'expérience en direction produit ou management d'équipes produit dans un environnement B2B / éditeur de logiciels. Orienté(e) business et marché, vous savez transformer les besoins clients et les enjeux commerciaux en stratégie produit. Vous êtes à l'aise avec les équipes commerciales, la gestion d'investissements et les arbitrages à forte valeur ajoutée. Compétences clés * Stratégie et vision produit multi-produits * Analyse de marché et veille concurrentielle * Leadership et management d'équipes * Construction et pilotage budgétaire * Culture data-driven et indicateurs business * IA appliquée au produit * Méthodologies Agile / Scrum Qualités attendues * Vision stratégique et sens des priorités * Leadership et capacité à fédérer * Sens de la décision et de l'arbitrage * Aisance avec les dirigeants et parties prenantes * Vision long terme et approche systémique Atouts appréciés * Gestion de produits à cycle de vie long ou de portefeuilles complexes * Expérience en environnement réglementé ou à forts enjeux de sécurité * Connaissance du secteur public, des élections ou certification Agile Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? * Un poste de direction à fort impact stratégique * Une participation clé à une refonte technologique ambitieuse * Une équipe Produit complète et structurée * Un environnement Agile favorisant innovation, IA et amélioration continue * Un cadre de travail attractif à Meylan, près de Grenoble Conditions * CDI - jusqu'à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine * Rémunération selon profil, avec environ 20 % de variable liée à l'atteinte des objectifs stratégiques * Localisation : Meylan (38) * Avantages : tickets restaurant, intéressement, séminaires d'entreprise * Prise de poste : dès que possible Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Global Operations Associate - Air freight
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport:&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.&nbsp;</p> <p>The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.</p></div><h4><strong>Please submit your CV in English!</strong></h4> <h4><strong>The opportunity:</strong></h4> <p>The role of the Operations Associate is a critical part of making Flexport’s mission to make global trade easy for everyone a reality. Flexport today connects almost 10,000 clients and suppliers across 109 countries. In this role, your direct customers are the partners within your region: our account management and customs teams, subcontractors, carriers, terminals and trucking providers. Your work directly supports Flexport’s end customers in achieving their logistics goals. Most importantly, you will play a pivotal role in building the next operational model at Flexport: allowing us to effectively scale to achieve our mission of making global trade easier for everyone.</p> <p>This role is designed to facilitate the movement of shipments while discovering and driving efficiencies that build and improve operations as part of our Global team. Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, and backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are building the intelligence layer that powers the legal industry. Every firm can license the same AI models, but no two firms share the same institutional knowledge. jobs.title: RF Engineer (GNSS)

Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As an RF Engineer (GNSS) in the Hardware (Electronics) team, you will own the radionavigation architecture of our products. Our systems need high-precision navigation and robust connectivity in contested, complex environments, and you will be the expert responsible for the RF subsystems, from antenna design to integration and compliance. You will design custom GNSS antennas and receiver modules, extend them towards CRPAs for GNSS-denied operations, and see each design through simulation, lab validation and flight tests. Based in Lausanne, Switzerland. Responsibilities Antenna Design: Design custom GNSS antennas and receiver modules for our products, and extend the work towards CRPAs (Controlled Reception Pattern Antennas) for GNSS-denied environments. Antenna Integration: Integrate all antennas (GNSS, radio link) into the drones, validating through simulation (gain diagrams) and real-life lab and flight testing. GNSS Test Bench: Develop, maintain and configure the GNSS test bench to simulate satellite constellations and interference scenarios. RF Measurement: Run hands-on characterization with network and spectrum analyzers, and simulate new antenna iterations with EM software. Electromagnetic Compatibility: Lead EMC troubleshooting and pre-compliance testing, identifying and removing blockers early. PCB Collaboration: Work with PCB designers to review routing, shielding and RF layout. Architecture Ownership: Review and own the RF architecture across product lines, including link budgets and system-level RF performance. Mentoring: Act as the team's RF subject matter expert, coaching junior engineers on RF layout principles and EMC mitigation. Candidate Requirements Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field. Experience: Proven track record taking complex wireless devices from concept to mass production, including clearing strict EMC compliance hurdles. Background in aerospace, commercial drones or GNSS products is a strong advantage. GNSS: Solid grounding in GNSS, including hands-on use of a GNSS test bench to simulate edge-case environments, and an understanding of effects such as multipath. Antenna Design: Experience designing custom antennas under tight mechanical and space constraints, with EM simulation tools. RF & EMC: Strong command of RF fundamentals and measurement equipment (network and spectrum analyzers); comfortable working in an anechoic chamber. Mindset: Analytical, meticulous, structured and resilient; a hands-on problem-solver who works autonomously and collaborates well. Communication & Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication, capable of leading diverse principals, from junior members to senior executives. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan. We groeien hard. Tot nu toe worden al onze warmtepompen geïnstalleerd door externe partners, maar daar komt verandering in. We gaan onze eigen installatieteams opbouwen en zoeken daarom een Hoofdmonteur Warmtepompen die hierin het voortouw neemt. Je bent een ervaren monteur die graag zelf de handen uit de mouwen steekt, maar ook energie krijgt van het begeleiden van anderen. Je gaat samen met je team op pad, bent verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit van de installaties en helpt ons om steeds meer monteurs op te leiden. Je komt dus niet in een bestaand team terecht. Je helpt het team zelf opbouwen. Wat ga je doen? Als Hoofdmonteur ben je verantwoordelijk voor de installatie van onze warmtepompen bij klanten thuis. Je begint met het leiden van ons eerste interne installatieteam en helpt ons om de komende jaren onze eigen installatiecapaciteit verder uit te bouwen. Je installeert warmtepompen en leidt je team Je gaat samen met een collega-monteur op pad om onze warmtepompen bij klanten thuis te installeren. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de volledige installatie, van de technische uitvoering en het oplossen van onverwachte problemen tot de oplevering. Je zorgt dat installaties veilig, efficiënt en volgens onze kwaliteitsstandaarden worden uitgevoerd. Je bent het aanspreekpunt voor de klant tijdens de installatie. Je legt uit wat jullie doen, beantwoordt vragen en zorgt dat de klant met een goed gevoel achterblijft. Je stemt waar nodig af met onze werkvoorbereiders en collega's op kantoor over planning, materialen en technische uitdagingen. Je bouwt mee aan ons interne installatieteam Je begeleidt en traint nieuwe monteurs en helpt hen om zelfstandig installaties uit te kunnen voeren. Je denkt mee over het aannemen van nieuwe collega's en hoe we ons installatieteam verder kunnen uitbreiden. Je helpt onze installatiestandaarden en werkwijzen verder te ontwikkelen. Je signaleert wat er in de praktijk beter of slimmer kan en neemt initiatief om dit te verbeteren. Je deelt feedback vanuit het veld met onze engineers, werkvoorbereiders en productontwikkelaars, zodat we onze producten en installaties continu kunnen verbeteren. Wie zoeken wij? We zoeken iemand die zijn vak goed verstaat, verantwoordelijkheid neemt en het leuk vindt om anderen beter te maken. Je hoeft niet eerder een heel team te hebben opgebouwd, maar je moet wel zin hebben om die uitdaging aan te gaan. Je hebt ruime ervaring met het installeren van warmtepompen, cv-installaties of andere verwarmingssystemen. Ervaring met warmtepompen heeft een sterke voorkeur. Je hebt een goede technische basis in installatietechniek, elektrotechniek en/of werktuigbouwkunde. Je kunt zelfstandig installaties uitvoeren, technische tekeningen lezen en onverwachte problemen oplossen. Je hebt ervaring met het begeleiden van andere monteurs, of bent klaar om die verantwoordelijkheid op je te nemen. Je werkt nauwkeurig en veilig en vindt het belangrijk om goed werk af te leveren. Je communiceert makkelijk met klanten en collega's en kunt technische zaken begrijpelijk uitleggen. Je neemt initiatief, denkt in oplossingen en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor het eindresultaat. Je spreekt goed Nederlands en hebt rijbewijs B. Een relevante mbo-opleiding en certificeringen zoals VCA, NEN 3140 of CO-vakmanschap zijn mooi meegenomen. Heb je nog niet alle benodigde certificaten? Dan kijken we samen wat je nog kunt behalen. Wat bieden wij jou? Een salaris van €4.000 tot €6.000 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van je ervaring. Een sleutelrol in ons bedrijf: je wordt de eerste Hoofdmonteur van ons interne installatieteam en helpt dit verder uit te bouwen.
