jobs.title: PLC Software Engineer - The Netherlands
jobs.description: Ready to build the software behind real-world renewable energy installations? At Bright Renewables, your PLC software doesn’t stay behind a desk. You’ll see it come to life in complex industrial installations for renewable gas and CO₂ technologies. As a PLC Software Engineer , you’ll be involved in the complete automation lifecycle - from software design and programming to testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimization. You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to technical decisions, help shape our automation standards, and work alongside experienced colleagues as part of an international software engineering team of around 10 engineers. Together, you’ll collaborate across the Netherlands, Latvia, and Poland to develop and deliver reliable, innovative automation solutions. Why this role? You’ll get the opportunity to: Own your solutions - contribute to software solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from design and programming to testing and commissioning; Work on real installations - solve automation challenges in complex renewable energy plants; Have technical influence - contribute to software standards, templates, concepts, and ways of working, within a team that values collaboration and embraces innovative ideas from everyone; Keep developing - work alongside experienced Electrical and Software Engineers and continue building your technical expertise; Work internationally - collaborate with colleagues and project teams in the Netherlands, Poland, Latvia and beyond, including regular international travel to visit our offices and project sites; Choose what works for you - work 32 or 40 hours per week, with flexible starting times and opportunities to work from home; Make an impact - use your automation expertise in technologies that contribute directly to the energy transition. What will you do? As a PLC Software Engineer, you design, develop, test, and commission PLC and SCADA control systems for technologies such as gas upgrading and CO₂ liquefaction. You report directly to the Manager E&I and Software and work closely with Electrical Engineers, Process Engineers and fellow Software Engineers . Depending on your experience, you’ll also have the opportunity to take more technical ownership, contribute to software concepts and standards, and support colleagues with complex automation challenges. Your responsibilities include: Designing, programming, testing, and commissioning PLC and SCADA systems ; Developing control software for gas upgrading, CO₂ liquefaction, and other renewable energy technologies; Taking ownership of your software from engineering through commissioning; Testing and troubleshooting software during commissioning and operation; Analyzing and resolving software and control-related issues in existing installations; Implementing software updates and optimizations; Supporting Service Engineers with more complex automation and software questions; Contributing to software standards, templates, and automation concepts; Working closely with Electrical Engineers, Software Engineers, and other technical disciplines; Sharing knowledge and supporting colleagues within the engineering team. What do you bring? We’re looking for someone who enjoys solving technical challenges and wants to take responsibility for their own engineering work. Ideally, you have: A completed technical education in automation, mechatronics, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related field; Several years of experience in PLC/SCADA engineering within an industrial environment; Hands-on experience in PLC programming, ideally with Siemens S7 and TIA Portal, combined with knowledge of WinCC SCADA, industrial communication networks, and remote access solutions. Experience with commissioning and troubleshooting industrial installations; A good understanding of automation architectures and industrial control systems; Good command of English, both spoken and written; Knowledge of OT security is a plus. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Who are we? Gain is the Private Markets Super App, a connected global platform transforming how leading investors, advisors, and corporates source, evaluate, and execute deals. By combining investment-grade intelligence, AI-powered workflows, and proprietary data in one unified platform, Gain enables top deal teams to move faster, reduce risk, and build conviction with confidence. Gain is trusted across more than $1 trillion of private capital, used by 100% of MBB and Big Four firms, and by 80% of the world’s top 20 M&A advisory houses. Recognized for fast innovation and impact, Gain has been named both US and EU Data Provider of the Year by PE Wire, awarded Global Financial Market Review’s Best Use of AI in Finance, and ranked in Sifted’s Top 100 Fastest-Growing Companies, the Forbes 1000, and the Deloitte Technology Fast 50. Gain operates globally with offices in New York, London, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Warsaw, and Bangalore. How we work Predicting what isn't published. Many private companies publish little or no financial detail. Across a database of more than 5 million companies, we predict revenue and EBITDA from sparse labels, and we predict whether and when a company will be bought or sold, which is a time-to-event problem with censored data. Agents on a messy web. Our agents search, navigate and extract company data points from sources that contradict each other, then decide which source to trust before committing to an answer. Quality that holds while everything underneath moves. We're provider-agnostic. Model choices follow the evals, and we switch LLMs when the numbers say so. That only works if the evals are trusted. What will you do? The work is roughly half LLM agents and half custom ML, leaning slightly toward agents. The design of our agent pipelines: architecture, tools, and which model for which task. You'll shape the technical direction with our AI Lead. The evaluation behind agents and models: offline reference sets, live production evals, and the call on whether an improvement is real. Our prediction models for financials and deals: features, validation, retraining, and knowing when a simpler model wins. Getting work into production: trace where pipelines fail and fix the weakest links first, with compute, memory and model cost in view. Raising the bar in the team through design reviews, pairing, and an eval-first habit that sticks. In your first six months you'll own the evals for our agent pipelines, propose where we invest next, and ship measurable improvements to both the agents and the prediction models. Who are you? You've built and owned ML systems in production for years, typically 6+ in ML or software engineering. In the last 1–2 years you've shipped LLM agents or pipelines that real users depend on, not demos. You have modelling judgement. You've dealt with leakage, distribution shift and calibration on real data. You measure before you claim. You can build an evaluation set and tell an honest improvement from a lucky one. You care about the user outcome more than the technique. Ideas without a clear customer benefit don't get built here, however interesting. Nice to have: time-to-event modelling, noisy or conflicting data sources, financial or private-company data. No finance background needed. The team You'll join our Data & AI team of six and report to Renan, our AI Lead who's been building production models for >10 years. Our engineering team runs the infrastructure, and you shape what runs on it. The stack Core: Python (async, fully typed with Pydantic) and FastAPI LLMs: multiple providers behind our own provider-agnostic layer, with Pydantic AI for typed agents. Evals and observability: Pydantic Evals and Logfire Data: PostgreSQL with pgvector Cloud: GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud Tasks), Docker, GitHub Actions What do we offer? We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together. Your impact As a Solutions Engineer I in the Connect team, you'll support the partners who bring processing volume to Mollie, think SaaS platforms and marketplaces. Your core activities are discovery, solution design, and implementation support for partner deals, the work that turns a promising conversation into a working integration. You'll also support events and pitches for the commercial team and contribute to process improvement and internal product feedback, so the lessons from one deal make the next one easier. Solutions Engineers are the bridge between technical and commercial teams at Mollie. Strong discovery means partners get solutions that actually fit, pricing negotiations become smoother, and partner needs and product issues make their way back into the business. That's a direct line to how Mollie expands into new products and partner segments. What you'll ship Lead technical discovery sessions to deeply understand and map complex merchant requirements. Build and deliver custom demos, proof-of-concepts (POCs), and technical workshops that prove our value. Act as the technical expert in the room, partnering with Account Executives to overcome objections and close strategic deals. What you'll bring 2 to 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing, technical role. Customer-facing experience with a technical product, such as pre-sales, solutions engineering, sales engineering, or technical customer success Comfortable working with APIs, with the ability to demo and build solutions on top of them Strong discovery skills: understanding what a partner needs and judging what's feasible with the product Ability to explain a complex product, including payment methods, sub-products, and the Connect proposition, to both technical and commercial audiences Experience working with both internal and external senior executives stakeholders A technically curious, commercially minded, and customer-minded approach, with clear rules of engagement, comfortable saying no and pushing back when needed Grow your way At Mollie, growth is personal. You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step. No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way. jobs.title: Data Analist
jobs.description: Zie jij snel welke data nodig is om een businessvraag te beantwoorden? Als Data Analist binnen het Data & AI Office analyseer je data, vertaal je vraagstukken uit de business naar concrete inzichten en help je collega’s om die inzichten te gebruiken voor betere beslissingen. Ook onderzoek je waar AI waarde kan toevoegen en werk je mee aan praktische toepassingen die de manier van werken verbeteren.   Je bent de schakel tussen de business en de specialisten binnen Data & AI. Daarmee zorg je ervoor dat goede ideeën niet blijven hangen in analyses of experimenten, maar leiden tot oplossingen die medewerkers daadwerkelijk gebruiken en die waarde opleveren voor onze leden. Wie ben jij Jij bent analytisch sterk en oprecht nieuwsgierig naar wat er binnen de business speelt. Je neemt geen genoegen met de eerste vraag, maar onderzoekt welk probleem er werkelijk moet worden opgelost en welke informatie nodig is om een goede beslissing te nemen. jobs.title: Quantitative Researcher - 2027 Graduates
jobs.description: At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge? As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly. This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job. Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices. What You'll Work On You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include: Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist. What Success Looks Like Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. Your impact isn't measured by how many models you build. It's measured by the quality of the ideas you discover and what those ideas enable. Who We're Looking For We're looking for exceptional problem solvers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious. Degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, computer science, statistics, operations research or machine learning No active backlogs Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++ Solid grounding in probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimization, with experience in machine learning, statistical modelling or data analysis, whether through coursework, research or personal projects Comfort working with large, complex datasets, and strong analytical thinking A passion for applying quantitative thinking and rigorous research to solve open-ended problems in markets Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly Prior exposure to quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, competitive mathematics or machine learning is valuable, but we care more about how you think than whether you've worked in finance b

jobs.title: Senior Projectmanager
jobs.description: Jouw Missie bij CCS Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam. Voordelen voor de sollicitant Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar). Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks. En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch? Een voorbeeld van je werkdag Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen. Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan. Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant. Wie jij bent De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten: · Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten; · Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope; · Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat; · Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig; · Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift; · Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch; · Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties; · Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica. Wat bieden wij jou? Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij

Dann werde Teil unseres Teams bei Aever Clinics in München! Über Aever Clinics Aever Clinics gehört zu einer wachsenden europäischen Klinikgruppe im Bereich Beauty, Hautgesundheit und ästhetische Behandlungen. Wir verbinden moderne Technologien, hochwertige Behandlungen und eine persönliche Betreuung, um unseren Kund erstklassige Ergebnisse zu ermöglichen. Du weißt, wer in Berlin was entscheidet. Arbeitsmarktdienstleistungen – Du kennst das Geschäft aus eigener Praxis: SGB II und SGB III, AZAV, AVGS, FBW, § 45, Ausschreibungen der Kostenträger, Integrations- und Berufssprachkurse. jobs.title: People Operations Partner
jobs.description: 📈 Who We Are: We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair. Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity. tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators. We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale. In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership. We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide. Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems. At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception. 🚀 The Role We're hiring a People Operations Partner to join our Performance team. tem is rebuilding the energy transaction - transparent, fair and built on trust. Behind that mission is a company growing fast, and a Performance team that's already lean and stretched. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle. At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth. We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. You’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary. Sales Director, EMEA This is a senior sales opportunity for an experienced commercial leader to drive Talos’s growth with banks and TradFi institutions as institutional finance moves into digital assets and tokenized, multi-asset trading. As Sales Director at Talos, you will own new business and key relationships across the UK, with a focus on banks and TradFi institutions entering digital assets. You will run the full deal lifecycle, from origination and discovery through solutioning, trials and close, partnering closely with Solutions and Account Management to make sure clients are set up for long-term success. Talos runs a structured, consultative sales environment. This role suits someone with an established TradFi network, a proven record of originating revenue, and the ability to clearly articulate how institutional trading infrastructure is changing. Responsibilities Originate and close new business across banks, broker-dealers and TradFi institutions, alongside Talos’s core client segments including hedge funds, market makers, prime brokers and digital asset service providers. Use and expand your network of senior bank and TradFi relationships to build a high-quality pipeline from day one. Lead senior-level discovery and demo conversations, mapping institutional workflows and requirements to Talos’s product capabilities. jobs.title: Research Scientist, Protein Design & Engineering
jobs.description: About us We're reverse-engineering the origin of life — one of the great unsolved problems in science, and one we think AI finally makes tractable. Understanding this transition, from geochemistry to biochemistry, is what will let us orchestrate molecular networks and build systems that are more capable, adaptive, and efficient. If we succeed, the applications are vast: catalysis, green synthesis, ab initio synthetic biology, programmable matter. Understanding and harnessing these processes could let ten billion of us thrive on this planet — and let life keep evolving beyond it. We're a small, diverse team of AI engineers, computational scientists, and bench scientists. We hold ourselves to the rigor of a research institute, but we ship like an engineering firm. Global team, HQs in Cambridge, MA and London, UK. The role You'll engineer proteins to carry out useful chemistry, combining enzyme discovery, directed evolution, and experimental characterisation. You'll own the experimental cycle: choosing starting points, building variant libraries, developing screens, and establishing which changes improve function and why. This is a hands-on role working closely with our computational and ML teams. You'll test designed proteins at the bench, use experimental results to guide subsequent rounds, and develop enzymes with the activity, selectivity, and stability needed for their intended application. There’s no fixed screening pipeline to inherit — you'll help decide how we build it. What you'll do Design and run protein engineering campaigns, from initial enzyme selection and library design through screening and characterisation of improved variants. Build and express variant libraries using site-directed, random, and combinatorial mutagenesis. Develop assays and high-throughput screens that reliably measure the properties we're trying to improve. Express, purify, and characterise proteins, measuring kinetics, substrate scope, selectivity, and stability under relevant reaction conditions. Work with computational scientists to test proposed designs, interpret successes and failures, and use the results to guide the next round. Develop enzymatic reactions and cascades, identifying how enzyme performance, cofactors, and reaction conditions affect overall productivity. Essential experience We're interested in the engineering campaigns you've run, the assays you've built, and what you learned from them. We care about: A track record of improving protein or enzyme function through directed evolution or rational engineering. Practical fluency in molecular biology, including cloning, library construction, mutagenesis, and recombinant protein expression. Experience developing and troubleshooting enzyme assays and screening workflows, with appropriate controls and follow-up validation. A solid grasp of enzyme mechanism, kinetics, and structure–function relationships, and the ability to use these to guide experiments. Experience independently taking projects through multiple design–build–test cycles and explaining what drove the results. Highly preferred Experience with industrial biocatalysis or engineering enzymes for demanding reaction conditions. Experience integrating liquid handling and laboratory automation with high-throughput screening. Familiarity with biosensor-based screens, growth-based selection, or FACS. Experience testing computationally designed proteins and feeding experimental results back into design. Experience with enzyme cascades, fermentation, or transferring enzymatic processes from the bench to larger scales. Logistics This is a full-time, on-site role in Cambridge, MA. jobs.title: Alliance & Delivery Manager, Pharma Partnerships
jobs.description: About Orakl Oncology At Orakl Oncology, we combine patient-derived tumor models, experimental drug screening and computational modelling to improve oncology drug development. Our research brings together functional treatment-response measurements, molecular profiles and clinical information where available, creating opportunities to investigate how experimental responses translate into patient outcomes. Our platforms are designed to help anticipate clinical trial outcomes, evaluate therapies and identify new therapeutic opportunities. Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalised. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology. About the Role We are looking for an Alliance & Delivery Manager to own Orakl's pharma partnerships after signature: the partner relationship, the delivery of each research program, and the growth of each account. Orakl runs research programs for pharmaceutical companies on its virtual patient cohorts, combining compound screening, multi-omics and O-Predict analyses on the partner's assets. Several programs run in parallel on the same wet-lab and dry-lab teams, and the portfolio is growing. Delivery quality directly drives renewals and follow-on contracts. This is a high-ownership, partner-facing role . You are the partner's main contact, you are accountable for delivery across our wet-lab and dry-lab teams, and you grow existing accounts. You will also scale our delivery processes and tooling: project tracking, capacity planning and partner reporting, automated wherever possible. You will work closely with the Scientific Program & Operations Lead, Business Development, the Wet Lab, Data Science and Computational Biology leads, and Product. As the ideal candidate, you have already delivered complex scientific programs for pharma clients, and you are an expert at establishing partner trust. What You'll Do Own partner relationships: act as the main point of contact for each pharma partner from kick-off to final delivery. Map decision-makers, priorities and expectations for their asset, run the steering committees, attend key international conferences a few times per year and present results alongside our scientific teams. Lead program delivery: translate each signed contract into an executable plan for the Wet Lab and Dry Lab teams, with owners, milestones and deliverables. Own the timeline, coordinate the experimental and computational work, and ensure every deliverable passes internal QC and review before it reaches the partner. Manage capacity across programs: plan capacity with the Wet Lab and Dry Lab leads, arbitrate conflicts between programs and protect committed timelines. Centralise requests on delivery teams coming from partners and Business Development. Manage risk and change: anticipate delivery risks, including results that change the plan, and escalate to the Scientific Program & Operations Lead with a recommendation. Agree and document scope and timeline changes with partners. Scale delivery processes and tooling: scale our project management system in Asana, from program templates and timelines to portfolio and capacity views. Automate reporting and follow-up, deploy AI tools where they remove manual work, and document how we run programs. Grow existing accounts: identify, qualify and convert follow-on opportunities within existing partnerships. Work with Business Development on scoping, proposals and pricing, and provide a feasibility assessment before anything is committed. Plan scientific and BD materials: schedule conference and BD material cycles as part of the delivery plan, and coordinate partner approvals for any communication based on partnered programs. Minimum Qualifications 4+ year

jobs.description: About Voodoo Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way. Team The Engineering & Data team builds innovative tech products and platforms to support the impressive growth of their gaming and consumer apps which allow Voodoo to stay at the forefront of the mobile gaming industry. Helix is our flagship Ad-Network team of around 60 top-tier engineers and data scientists spanning backend, mobile SDKs, data engineering, infrastructure, and AI. Helix has evolved beyond powering Voodoo's own gaming portfolio—our technology is now directly integrated into games from external, third-party publishers worldwide. Operating across millions of third-party devices in real-time bidding environments creates unique technical challenges around SDK performance, ultra-low latency, and intelligent automation. Within Helix, you'll join the RTB team, the group that owns the bidder and the services behind it that help it take the optimal bidding decision. Bidder, pricing, models and data are all built in-house, so nothing is out of reach when you want to change how a bid gets made. You will work with expert backend and machine-learning engineers in real-time bidding, on a system that prices ad requests across mobile gaming in real time, at a scale few teams get to work at. Role We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager - Real Time Bidding to join our Engineering & Data team. In this role, you’ll drive product decisions across the full bidding pipeline. You'll own projects end-to-end: roadmap, trade-offs, shipping, and cross-team contract. You will also: Own the roadmap of the bidding pipeline. How we target, price, pace and cap, and what goes live in the bid path and when. Own the delivery. Adapt to changes, set clear priorities, communicate effectively Own experimentation as a product. You spot a change in one team that will break another before it reaches production. Contribute to the product strategy beyond your scope. Profile (Must have) Experience in programmatic advertising. You have worked on pricing, bidding or auction logic on a DSP, bidder or exchange, you know the pipeline from bid request to win, and you can explain the business impact of your work. Analytical mindset. You back decisions with data and understand the statistical basis of pricing and experimentation. You own outcomes across teams. When a change in one team is about to break another, you catch it and drive the fix before it ships. You use AI tooling daily to write specs, analyse data and prototype, and you move faster because of it. jobs.title: Apporteur d’affaires indépendant (H/F)
jobs.description: 🚀 Apporteur d’affaires indépendant — Développez votre réseau avec PropertyOS 100 % à distance · Organisation libre · Commission sur les ventes issues de vos recommandations Vous aimez créer des contacts, repérer des opportunités et mettre les bonnes personnes en relation ? Avec PropertyOS, vous identifiez des propriétaires, bailleurs ou petites agences intéressés par une gestion immobilière plus simple. Vous organisez le rendez-vous : le fondateur assure la démonstration et le closing. 🏡 PropertyOS, c’est quoi ? PropertyOS est une plateforme SaaS qui centralise les biens immobiliers, les locataires, les finances, les documents et les tâches dans un même espace. Notre ambition : permettre aux propriétaires et gestionnaires de gagner du temps et de garder une vision claire de leur activité immobilière. La plateforme est accessible directement en ligne. Nous développons également un réseau de partenaires indépendants pour la faire découvrir à de nouveaux clients grâce à une approche plus personnelle. 🎯 Votre mission : créer des opportunités qualifiées Votre rôle consiste à : Identifier des propriétaires bailleurs, investisseurs et petites agences susceptibles d’être intéressés. Entrer en contact avec eux et comprendre leur organisation actuelle. Présenter simplement PropertyOS et son intérêt. Vérifier leur intérêt pour une démonstration et pour le budget proposé. Organiser un rendez-vous avec le fondateur. Enregistrer les informations utiles dans PropertyOS Advisor pour préparer l’échange. Vous vous concentrez sur la prospection et la mise en relation. Le fondateur prend ensuite le relais pour la démonstration détaillée, les questions commerciales, la négociation et la conclusion de l’abonnement. Vous ne négociez pas les conditions et ne signez pas de contrat au nom de PropertyOS. ⚡ PropertyOS Advisor : votre application partenaire Vous disposez de PropertyOS Advisor , notre application dédiée aux apporteurs d’affaires. Pensée pour fluidifier votre activité, elle vous permet de centraliser les informations de vos prospects, suivre vos mises en relation et transmettre le contexte nécessaire à la préparation des rendez-vous. L’objectif : une prospection organisée et un passage de relais simple , pour donner à chaque opportunité les meilleures chances d’aboutir. 💸 Une rémunération liée aux clients apportés L’offre mise en avant dans ce partenariat est l’abonnement annuel PropertyOS à 990 € . Vous percevez une commission pour chaque nouveau client qui souscrit et règle cet abonnement à la suite de votre mise en relation, selon les conditions prévues au contrat. Rémunération à la commission uniquement. Aucun salaire fixe ni revenu garanti. Le montant de la commission et le calendrier de versement sont communiqués avant tout engagement. Les règles d’attribution des prospects, de traitement des doublons et d’annulation sont précisées au contrat. Un rendez-vous seul ne déclenche pas de commission : celle-ci dépend de la souscription et de l’encaissement correspondants. 👋 À qui s’adresse cette opportunité ? À des personnes autonomes, à l’aise dans les échanges et capables de créer un premier contact de qualité. Vous pouvez avoir une expérience commerciale, un réseau dans l’immobilier ou simplement une vraie capacité à prospecter avec méthode. Nous recherchons surtout : De l’écoute , pour repérer un besoin réel. De la clarté , pour expliquer la solution sans faire de promesses excessives. De la régularité , pour développer votre activité. De la rigueur , pour transmettre des informations fiables. Un bon relationnel , pour représenter PropertyOS avec professionnalisme. Une expérience en prospection, en immobilier ou dans le SaaS est un atout. Vous n’avez pas besoin d’être un expert du logiciel ni un closer confirmé. 🌴 Notre culture : détendue, directe et orientée résultats Chez PropertyOS, on apprécie les échanges simples, les idées utiles et les personnes qui prennent des initiatives. Vous organisez librement votre activité : pas d’horaire

jobs.title: Stage bedrijfsadministratie - office and management support
jobs.description: Meer leren. Meer doen. Meer carrière. Dat is stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer. Eindelijk kun je de theorie in de praktijk toepassen: jij hebt er zin in, en wij ook! Als stagiair Administratief Medewerker / Secretaresse krijg jij de kans om mee te draaien binnen een dynamische werkomgeving. Je ondersteunt collega's bij uiteenlopende administratieve en organisatorische werkzaamheden en zorgt ervoor dat alles achter de schermen soepel verloopt. Geen dag is hetzelfde. Je werkt samen met verschillende collega's, krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid en leert hoe een professionele organisatie in de bouwsector functioneert. Dit wordt jouw stage Tijdens deze meewerkstage maak je onderdeel uit van het secretariaat of een ondersteuningsteam binnen Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Rotterdam. Je bent een belangrijke schakel in de dagelijkse gang van zaken en helpt collega's bij het organiseren, plannen en administratief ondersteunen van hun werkzaamheden. Je krijgt de kans om verschillende werkzaamheden op te pakken en ontdekt hoe je met een goede planning, nauwkeurige administratie en sterke communicatie het verschil kunt maken binnen een organisatie. Samen met jouw stagebegeleider kijken we welke werkzaamheden het beste aansluiten bij jouw opleiding en leerdoelen. Wat ga je doen? Je ondersteunt bij uiteenlopende administratieve en organisatorische werkzaamheden, zoals: Het verwerken en beheren van administratieve gegevens; Het plannen en organiseren van afspraken, overleggen en bijeenkomsten; Het beheren van agenda's en mailboxen; Het opstellen, controleren en verwerken van documenten; Het ondersteunen van collega's bij diverse organisatorische werkzaamheden; Je werkt hierbij nauw samen met collega's uit verschillende teams en afdelingen. Dit is jouw team Je komt terecht in een betrokken en professioneel team waar samenwerken centraal staat. Collega's helpen elkaar graag en zorgen ervoor dat jij je snel thuis voelt. Tijdens jouw stage krijg je goede begeleiding en volop ruimte om nieuwe vaardigheden te ontwikkelen. Zo leer je niet alleen de praktijk kennen, maar ontdek je ook waar jouw talenten liggen. Dit bieden wij jou Een stagevergoeding van €700 per maand op basis van 40 uur per week; Veel ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen; Intensieve begeleiding tijdens jouw stage; Een afwisselende stage met veel verantwoordelijkheid; De mogelijkheid om ervaring op te doen binnen een van de grootste bouwbedrijven van Nederland; De beste collega's om het vak van te leren én een fijne werksfeer. Dit breng je mee Je volgt een mbo- of hbo-opleiding in de richting van Management Assistent, Office & Management Support, Bedrijfsadministratie of vergelijkbaar; Je bent nauwkeurig, georganiseerd en servicegericht; Je kunt goed plannen en overzicht bewaren; Je maakt makkelijk contact en communiceert prettig met collega's en externe contacten; Je bent proactief en pakt werkzaamheden zelfstandig op; Je bent beschikbaar voor een meewerkstage van minimaal 4 dagen per week. Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijnvisie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.    Meer weten? Neem contact op met onze Campus

jobs.title: Senior iOS Developer (Remote)
jobs.description: About Finom   Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.   We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.   Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.   At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.   Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business. The Role For hundreds of thousands of European entrepreneurs, our iOS app is Finom. It's how they check their cash flow over morning coffee, approve a payment between client meetings, and freeze a card the moment something looks off. We're mobile-first by conviction, not convenience — the app isn't a companion to the "real" product; it is the product. And as an AI-native platform, the features you build increasingly carry intelligence inside them: AI-powered accounting, smart categorization, and agentic workflows that quietly save business owners hours every week. When you ship something great, someone somewhere feels it the same day. That's why we're not looking for someone to implement tickets. Location: Utrecht region (head office in Tricht, Gelderland) About Intero Integrity Intero Integrity is an internationally operating specialist in the inspection, maintenance and emission monitoring of pipelines and industrial assets. We develop our inspection technology entirely in-house: from ultrasonic measurement systems and FPGA signal processing to the software our analysts use to interpret hundreds of kilometres of pipeline data. Reliability and correctness are therefore not a nice-to-have, but an absolute requirement. We operate across Europe, North America and the Middle East. Our software products sit at the heart of that work: they are used every day by our data analysis organisation around the world. Whatever you build here has a direct, global impact. What makes it attractive is the mix. You mentor and guide our internal developers, setting an example in how we design, review and test. At the same time you work side by side with our external development partners. Learning from them, challenging them and making sure the work meets a high bar. You'll grow as an engineer and as a mentor, often in the same week. Because our data is used for safety-critical decisions, a strong sense of software quality runs through the role: it shapes how you design, how you review and where you set the standard for the team. jobs.title: Senior Integrity Engineer
jobs.description: Senior Integrity Engineer Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it. Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe. About Intero Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities. Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity . Your team You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department. Together the team delivers integrity reports for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients. Why this role matters An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. The Integrity team turns inspection results into a complete solution package: assessments, remaining life, and clear recommendations that help operators make well-founded decisions about the continued operation of their systems. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on. What your week looks like Part of your week goes to performing integrity assessments on pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers. The other part goes to supporting business development, developing methods and giving technical support. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves. HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a usable answer. This is done with agents: specialised AI components that each take on part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can’t just sound convincing. It has to be correct, and you need to be able to see which source it comes from. This isn’t a pilot: the platform is in production and used heavily every day. As a senior, you build alongside the team, but you also keep the bigger picture in view. You know the different parts of the platform and how they affect one another. You help prioritise, spot obstacles early and make sure we’re heading in the right direction, both in how we work and technically. jobs.description: Who We Are Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too. We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more. Our team is small relative to our impact, and we believe our user success is our success (not the inverse). A team member summarized: “Roboflow is a company full of giant brains and tiny egos.” We find software has a multiplier effect on all roles (not only product and engineering), so Roboflow employs developers across the company in design, sales, customer support, marketing, and beyond. We’re supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Google Ventures, Y Combinator, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors. What You'll Do As a Research Scientist, you will originate and drive the novel machine learning research directions that shape Roboflow's research agenda. Because of Roboflow’s huge userbase, we have a unique visibility into how people are using computer vision in the real world, including in what circumstances existing methods are unable to solve user problems. Our Research Team’s mission is to introduce novel methods that generalize as well as possible across our userbase. This includes methods that learn well on diverse data, run efficiently on different hardware targets, and solve unique categories of problems. You will identify the most promising open problems in computer vision, develop original theoretical approaches and algorithms to address them, and publish your work at top conferences. You'll partner closely with our engineering team, who will take your research and translate it into production systems running at scale. Who You Are You are a pragmatic, experienced machine learning researcher who wants to be an important part of an exceptional team that focuses on using Roboflow's computer vision tools to impact and improve every industry. We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. Our Merchant of Record model gives us a data position no PSP or billing provider has: subscription and pricing context alongside granular payment-outcome data, across thousands of software businesses. This role exists to turn that into economic value by putting machine learning and agentic systems into production. The mandate is deliberately narrow and deliberately ambitious: data science at Paddle owns automated decisioning inside the product — traditional machine learning and agentic systems alike — not decision-support analytics. We have a long list of candidate opportunities than we can fund, spanning payment performance and revenue recovery, sales and marketing operations, growth and monetisation intelligence, and risk, trust and compliance. We have a working hypothesis about which of these pays back first, and we'll share it — but part of the job in your first quarter is to pressure-test it, size the alternatives yourself, and tell us where to start. This is a founding role, and for the first few quarters it is a building role more than a managing one. You'll be the only person in the function: doing the analysis, engineering the features, training and evaluating the models or agents, taking the first system live with our engineering teams — and then operating it, answerable for its uptime, its drift and its numbers. Once the first use cases are proving out, you'll hire and lead a hub-and-spoke team of data scientists and machine learning engineers embedded across our highest-value business areas. You'll report into the VP of Data and work in close partnership with Product, Payments, Engineering, Risk and Finance. What you'll do: Prioritise which opportunities have the biggest impact.. Build a value-based use-case backlog across payment performance and revenue recovery, sales and marketing operations, growth and monetisation intelligence, and risk, trust and compliance; size the leading candidates properly; and make the call on sequencing with the relevant Product, Risk, RevOps and Finance stakeholders. This gets refreshed quarterly. Personally deliver the first system end to end: the analysis and back-test, the features, the model, policy or agent, the deployment, and the shadow and A/B tests that prove it works. Not a spec handed to someone else to build. Operate what you deploy. Own monitoring, retraining, drift response, incident handling and rollback for live decisioning, alongside the engineering teams whose services call it — and set the expectation that the function runs its systems rather than shipping them. jobs.description: About the Role Elite Editing is seeking experienced freelance journalists and content professionals to support our growing customer reference and case study programs. Write polished B2B case studies and customer reference stories based on the information you gather, following client-specific briefs, templates, standards, and style guides. jobs.description: At Netflix , our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. This is a foundational role on a small, high-leverage team. You will build the analytics and data infrastructure that powers identity matching and graph construction — designing the tables, pipelines, and metrics that let the team and its stakeholders understand match quality, coverage, and drift over time.
